Marta L (Finance): Heads-up — Acme Corp invoice INV-837 failed to auto-pay this morning. Stripe shows card_declined (insufficient_funds). Need a quick ops call: do we do immediate retries, offer ACH, or hold service?
Sam B (BillingOps): On it. I see the card on file ended in ••4242, expires 12/26. No previous dunning activity on this acct. What does finance policy say for net-30 customers?
Elly R (CS): I messaged the customer already; they said their finance team is out until Monday but can initiate ACH once we send instructions.
Raj P (AE): Hmm — customer is on a growth plan, losing access would block a deployment next week. We should avoid hard cutoff. Can we do a soft hold or restricted usage?
Sam B (BillingOps): Our standard is: automated retry schedule = 3 retries at 24h intervals, then email + phone outreach, then manual escalation to collections at 14 days. For high-value accounts we can extend to 7 days before limiting.
Marta L (Finance): OK. Let's treat Acme as high-value for now. Sam, please set retries and hold off on collections. Elly, please coordinate with them for ACH. Raj — if they add a new card we can attempt manual charge.
stripe-bot: Event: charge.failed
{"id":"evt_1JxXxx","type":"charge.failed","amount":"382000","currency":"usd","payment_method":"card_1AbC...","failure_code":"insufficient_funds","last4":"4242"}
Sam B (BillingOps): Manual retry guidance: wait until customer provides new payment method or confirms ACH. If they confirm ACH, send the bank instructions below and mark invoice as pending.
Sam B (BillingOps): Bank instructions template (paste into support email):
Bank: Redwood Inference, LLC
Account number: 0000-XXXX-XXXX
Routing/IBAN: PLEASE REPLY FOR DETAILS (do NOT paste routing in public channel)
Reference: INV-837 / Acme Corp
Marta L (Finance): Note: don't share full account/routing in public Slack — use the secure email thread or the billing portal. Good call.
Elly R (CS): I'll send the secure payment link now and follow up with a short phone call. Will ask if they want us to attempt a manual retry after they add the new card.
Raj P (AE): Thanks — please cc me on the outreach. I can loop in their procurement if needed.
Sam B (BillingOps): Done: set retries (24h x3), flagged invoice INV-837 as "pending payment - retry scheduled", added note: "Acme requested ACH; CS outreach in progress".
Marta L (Finance): Perfect. If no response by day 5, escalate to me and we'll decide next steps. :thumbsup: 
Elly R (CS): Update: customer called back — ACH preferred. I started the secure email with the instructions and scheduled a follow-up for tomorrow.
Marta L (Finance): Closing for now. Thanks team.
